summary: Comprehensive plan to: (1) hide bottom navigation tabs when a note is opened, (2) redesign and align the docked formatting toolbar with cursor auto-centering inside formatting tags like **|**, (3) implement live in-place Obsidian-style Markdown rendering via Compose VisualTransformation/AnnotatedString with simultaneous background disk saving, and (4) link Desk directly to the active vault so sample notes are only seeded into that specific vault when empty.
